remarks: Savor the gorgeous late summer weather in spectacular Rowayton! September 4-Oct 3: $17,500 (heated pool will be open). Please inquire for additional months. Enjoy Rowayton living in the Frederic E. Lockwood House (circa 1897). This designer renovated Victorian has amenities galore - a gorgeous in-ground heated saltwater pool with dramatic landscape lighting and sculpture; an entertaining deck with gas grill and seating overlooking the property; and modern eat-in kitchen/ family room with marble counters; Viking range; and fireplace just steps away. Completing the main level, you'll be delighted by the office, dining room, and living room with door to the front porch, featuring a relaxing swing - the perfect spot for an afternoon refreshment. Upstairs, is a grand primary master suite with fireplace, ensuite bath with double sinks, and walk-in closet. Also on this level, are two additional bedrooms plus a hall bath with laundry. On the third floor/ attic level, there is a sweet bedroom with lounge area. Minutes away from downtown Rowayton and Metro North. Convenient to Pinkney Park and Rowayton resident Bayley Beach Park (open access after Labor Day. Feel like you're in the Hamptons, with the benefit of a short commute to NYC via Metro North. Dogs welcome - inquire about restrictions and policy.
